subject: Security onramp: MAP, retention windows & DPA items
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@treasurebank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff & SOC 2 / DPA asks

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to line up a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can finish security clearance and be in a position to sign by the end of November. Can you confirm the following so we can scope our internal reviewers?:

- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can share with our auditors?
- Can you provide the SIG/CAIQ self-assessment and the location where we can download it?
- What's Redwood's default data retention window for hosted deployments and can it be shortened to 90 days for sensitive PII?
- We'd like to start with your hosted API; will a Private/VPC deployment be required for full production (TBD on our side).

I've attached a brief MAP template (TreasureBank_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones: security review, DPA redline, procurement approval, and SOC2 evidence review. Goal: close by 2026-11-30.

Can Ben or your legal/compliance folks weigh in on the DPA timeline?

Cheers,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Security — TreasureBank
security@treasurebank.com

Attachment: TreasureBank_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@treasurebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & SOC 2 / DPA asks

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear plan and target date. Attaching a short MAP that maps our typical evidence handoff and expected cadence. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-06). We'll provide the report under NDA and can host a read-only link for your audit team.
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain an up-to-date self-assessment; I'll share the XLS and an exported PDF.
- Retention: Default hosted retention is 365 days for logs and 180 days for payload token traces. We can offer a 90-day retention profile for a Hosted tenant under a contractual carveout, but we need to confirm SLA/availability implications.
- Private/VPC: Not required to start evaluation; often customers choose Private later for regulatory reasons.

Ben/Kimberly — can you review the attached DPA draft (Redwood_DPA_draft.pdf) and the proposed retention carveout? Would appreciate high-level redlines by Tue 10/20 so we can keep the MAP moving.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync with your security and procurement teams next week.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_draft.pdf (PDF), MAP_close-plan-20261020.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & SOC 2 / DPA asks

Sofia / Kimberly —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick legal/compliance notes after a first pass of the DPA draft:

1) Data residency: TreasureBank should confirm if they require EU/UK residency. If yes, we need to scope Private or a dedicated region deployment. Our hosted EU region supports at-rest and in-transit controls but not guaranteed physical separation unless we offer a dedicated instance.
2) Retention carveout: We can agree a 90-day retention on request but must mark it as a Customer-specific configuration in the SOW and include an SLA impact clause (possible slightly reduced caching effectiveness, which may increase per-token cost).
3) Audit/evidence: SOC 2 report can be shared under NDA; SIG/CAIQ export will be available within two business days. For any live pen testing or security attestations, we'll need a 2-week notice.

I've attached suggested redlines (DPA_redlines.docx) with tracked changes and a short comment summary. If TreasureBank wants a faster close, we should lock in the retention carveout and a conditional acceptance clause so procurement can move forward while legal completes redlines.

Ben
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_redlines.docx (Word)

From: Elena Morales <elena@treasurebank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: TreasureBank Security <security@treasurebank.com>, Procurement <procurement@treasurebank.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & SOC 2 / DPA asks

Hi Ben / Sofia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Residency: We do not require EU residency for this project; US multi-tenant hosted is acceptable for now.
- Retention: 90 days default for token traces would be ideal. Can you confirm whether logs (audit & access logs) follow the same 90-day window or remain at 365? We need audit logs for our internal compliance team.
- SOC 2: We'll sign an NDA today to get the Type II report.

We are happy to accept a conditional acceptance clause for the retention carveout provided the SOW flags any operational caveats. Proposed sync: Tue 10/20 11:00 AM PT for a 30-min call with our security + procurement.

Thanks,
Elena

P.S. Procurement asked whether a DocuSign preview of a preliminary SOW/DPA would help accelerate internal approvals. If you can provide that, we'll queue Legal to review concurrently.

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@treasurebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & SOC 2 / DPA asks

Thanks — confirmed for Tue 10/20 11:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).

Action items we've executed and artifacts attached for your review:

- Redwood provided: SOC 2 Type II (NDA link will be shared at the call), SIG/CAIQ export, and the DPA draft with Ben's redlines.
- Retention profile: We will offer 90-day token trace retention and a 90-day audit-log retention for this tenant under a contractual carveout. We'll call this the "90-day evaluation retention" in the SOW. Any change to shorter windows may require an operational review.
- SOW & Signing: Attached is a DocuSign preview of a preliminary SOW and the MAP close-plan (MAP_close-plan-20261020.pdf). Please have Procurement confirm whether conditional acceptance is sufficient to proceed.

If Procurement wants an explicit acceptance checklist we can add one to the MAP (evidence items + owner + due date) during the call.

Looking forward to the sync.

— Sofia
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_close-plan-20261020.pdf (PDF), DocuSign preview link: https://docusign.net/Signing/?s=abcdef123456
